text.p: Tropical cyclone Gavin will continue to be a threat to shipping north of New Zealand for the next 36 hours. Top winds, currently near 90 mph, should decrease to 55 mph during this period. The storm will be over open water through 36 hours but it could bring rain and wind to the north island of New Zealand in about 48 hours as an extratropical storm system.

Tropical cyclone Justin will remain a significant risk to shipping in Coral Sea to the east of Cairns, Australia over the next few days. Top winds are currently 60 mph but they may increase to 65-70 mph during the next 48-72 hours. The system is currently about 350 miles east of Cairns and is nearly stationary. It should drift westward for the next 24-48 hours. This track will keep it well east of the Australia coast for the next few days but it does bear watching.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
